message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "Verify Subtle Morphological Findings via Direct Image Inspection", "description": "When automated chest X-ray classifiers return low confidence scores for subtle structural patterns, rely on direct visual inspection of image pixels rather than accepting negative tool outputs.", "applicable_conditions": "Tasks involving medical imaging interpretation where automated diagnostic tools yield inconclusive or negative results for fine-grained morphological features (e.g., interstitial changes, small cysts, reticulonodular opacities).", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_classifier"], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If `chest_xray_classifier` returns no strong findings (scores below threshold) for suspected subtle morphological patterns: (1) Do not hallucinate findings or over-interpret the negative output; (2) Perform direct visual inspection of the original image pixels to identify specific features such as lucencies or reticulonodular opacities; (3) Use the classifier output primarily to rule out gross pathology (e.g., large masses, effusions) while trusting pixel-level evidence for subtle anomalies if supported by clinical context."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
